instruction.name: vpickev.w
instruction.description: For each 128-bit lane, place even-positioned 32-bit elements of `b` into its lower half and even-positioned 32-bit elements of `a` into its upper half.

latencies.notes: measured with a dependent chain. Unroll 20000, iters 500. Raw measurement was 1.00; the residual is a systematic calibration offset, so the recorded value is the nominal integer with the observed spread.

throughput.name: 8 independent lanes
